critical_code_review_comments: OrgSettings is only rendered inside the 'ملف المؤسسة' sub-tab of OwnerMore. The task phrasing 'open tab-more → org settings' may mislead QA; consider renaming the segment or adding a direct testID like 'segment-profile' on the Segments option so tests can navigate deterministically instead of using Arabic text selectors.

convex/dailySms.ts summarize() queries all sales + collections with by_org and filters in memory by created_at >= day start. For orgs with many historical rows this is O(N) per preview and is also run inside the preview query every GET. Consider a dedicated by_org_created_at index or at least cache the daily aggregate.

DailySmsSection in OrgSettings.tsx defaults 'enabled' to true while q.data is still loading (line 18). On slow networks the switch flashes ON then may jump OFF when data arrives — minor UX but worth guarding behind q.isLoading.
